name: R101-clefable-metronome-weather-ball-sandstorm
why: Challenge 7. The player's Clefable (389, Metronome 10 PP) calls Metronome 10 times in a row opposite Shuckle (528: Sandstorm, Dig, Flash, Double Team; Attack 10, so it cannot knock Clefable out); every call is a draw of one of the 336 callable moves (1 in 336 each). After the tenth call the script switches to Salamence (753) and plays Aerial Ace (slot 2; it never misses, so a Double Team stack cannot stall the end; luck6). Weather Ball by Metronome while Shuckle's Sandstorm is up (the AI scores Sandstorm up when no weather is set) makes it a Rock move (any of the three weather arms counts). Chance per seed about 10/336 x P(sandstorm up) 0.7 = 2%.
